name: openmerchant-custom
description: Search product and service catalogs for business purchases, track supplier bills and payment holds, and manage account purchases, profiles, budgets, policies, and merchant listings. Use for ordinary shopping and finance requests without naming OpenMerchant; connect with the account or an API key.

interface.longDescription: Find products and services for business purchases, check catalog prices and stock, submit and track supplier invoices, inspect purchase requests, manage profiles, budgets and spending policies, and configure your own merchant catalog. Use ordinary shopping, finance, or store-management requests; you do not need to name OpenMerchant. Submitted invoices from known vendors within your limits can be paid automatically under your account's rules. Sign in with your OpenMerchant account and choose test or live mode.
